title: Check the taxpayer own MisPagos history when the payer uses a different certificate
blocker: The isolated taxpayer session and fail-closed checks are implemented and covered using synthetic responses. A real two-certificate read-only plan and a definitive empty-history sample remain unverified.
unblock: Provide a redacted verified empty-history response and authorize one read-only plan for a known paid receipt using the payer and taxpayer certificates.
notes: differs from the obligado.** Debiting the account needs the account
holder's certificate, but the already-paid guard reads MisPagos for the
certificate holder only. Verified 2026-11-06: an entity's paid 010 is
detected when the plan runs with that entity's certificate, and is
invisible with the payer's. Smallest step: an optional second certificate
(`--cert-obligado/--key-obligado`) used only for the MisPagos check.
